# Lutz Finger

> Head of AI at Zoovu, Data Scientist in Residence at Cornell SC Johnson,
> Venture Partner at Cherry Ventures, Forbes contributor. Two founder exits
> (R2Decide 2025, Fisheye Analytics 2013). Ex-Google, ex-LinkedIn, ex-Snap.
> Writes and speaks on AI workflows, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO),
> LLM moats, and AI in e-commerce, healthcare, and education.

Image: https://www.lutzfinger.com/img/lutz-headshot-800.jpg

Ask Lutz anything: hello@lutzfinger.com. Public Q&A below pulls answers from his archive.

## Canonical pages
- [About](https://www.lutzfinger.com/about/): biography, current roles, exits, education.
- [Writing](https://www.lutzfinger.com/writing/): every published piece — Forbes column, LinkedIn Pulse articles, Intereconomics, NZZ.
- [Forbes column](https://www.lutzfinger.com/writing/forbes/): 54 articles on AI products, GEO, LLM moats, healthcare, policy.
- [Speaking](https://www.lutzfinger.com/speaking/): upcoming keynotes, workshops, conference sessions.
- [Keynote series](https://www.lutzfinger.com/keynote/): "The Keynote on AI" — live series with practitioners.
- [Workshops](https://www.lutzfinger.com/workshop/): two hands-on AI agent workshops with eCornell.
- [Q&A](https://www.lutzfinger.com/qa/): 41 curated answers from his writing, tagged.
- [Portfolio](https://www.lutzfinger.com/portfolio/): AI use cases he has shipped — search & discovery, social-media analytics, cloning influencers, audiobook summarization, preventable-admissions prediction, the SAI personal AI client, the LinkedIn "Future Me" model.
- [Book](https://www.lutzfinger.com/book/): *Ask, Measure, Learn* (O'Reilly, 2014) with Soumitra Dutta.
- [eCornell Certificate](https://www.lutzfinger.com/ecornell/): "Designing and Building AI Solutions" — the five-course certificate he teaches.

## Topics he writes and speaks about
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) — being discoverable to AI assistants instead of Google.
- LLM moats — eval data, distribution, why model-only moats erode.
- AI workflows — why redesigning work around AI beats bigger models.
- AI in e-commerce — fine-tuned models, attribution, the death of category search.
- AI in healthcare — value-based care, the data-quality problem, preventable admissions.
- AI in education — Cornell AI Teaching Assistant, how the MBA skillset is shifting.
- Product strategy for AI — "good enough" beats perfect, the value translation gap.
- AI policy — regulation, fairness, deepfakes, EU strategy, geopolitical implications.
